title: Research Design and Knowledge Mobilization in CYFCS
description: Introduces advanced research methodologies and research design in the field of child, youth, family and community studies. Knowledge production and knowledge mobilization and how to effectively apply these concepts to research projects is explored. Topics covered include designing and conducting research studies, analyzing data and communicating research findings to various stakeholders. Practical skills and knowledge are gained to help students create meaningful and impactful research in their future careers.
notes: Credit will be granted for one of CYC 644, CYC 643, CYC 645.
